cards.name: Giáp Dực Phong
cards.body:
Khai Dạng trong lượt này.
Sau hành động vũ khí đầu tiên, có thể đổi một lá trên tay lấy lá trên cùng chồng rút.
cards.subject: A SPADES / WIND: a majestic rhinoceros beetle creature, unmistakable one long upward-curving central RHINOCEROS horn, broad heavy wing cases lifted to reveal flowing pale jade translucent flight wings, six grounded articulated insect legs, charcoal and antique gold chitin with muted teal reflected light. Three-quarter front side view facing left. Lean broad sweeping wind ribbons and a few drifting leaves establish wind manipulation, not lightning. Ancient blue teal ruin courtyard with clear atmospheric depth. Do not use stag mandibles or antlers; this Ace must look distinct from the stag beetle Ace.
cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete front face of an Ashborne beast-seal Ace playing card, portrait 2:3, flat orthographic view, high resolution. This is a NEW painted version consistent with the approved card family, not a photograph of a card.
Input image 1 is the approved card reference for creature identity, card architecture and typography. Input image 2 is the binding game painting style. Match matte stylized 2D hand-painted big color planes, organic silhouettes, clear grounded anatomy, cold atmospheric ruins, selected warm ochre highlights. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, excessive textures, complex ornaments, existing franchise characters.
Layout: rounded warm ivory parchment card nearly filling canvas with all edges visible; narrow left column containing suit above A; upper illustration in thin aged bronze frame, restrained corner fittings and small centered top clasp carrying suit. Illustration occupies upper 65%; below it a navy title band, centered category, quiet ivory rules area. Bottom-right inverted A and suit. Match proportions of image 1. Black suits charcoal; red suits muted crimson. Title elegant soft humanist serif italic; body readable upright serif with correct Vietnamese diacritics, visually following Ashborne Veil v0.3. No extra costs, statistics, labels, logos or watermark.
Repaint a fresh composition with full creature silhouette readable inside the artwork; retain its specified identity, palette and elemental cues.

cards.name: Đường Lang Lưỡi Hồng
cards.body:
Khai Dạng trong lượt này.
Đòn vũ khí đầu tiên gieo than, đòn kế tiếp vào cùng mục tiêu làm than bùng.
cards.subject: A HEARTS / FIRE: one unmistakable praying mantis creature with elegant triangular head, two antennae, long neck/prothorax, TWO prominent curved raptorial sickle forelegs and four slender supporting walking legs, six legs total. Scarlet and burnt vermilion carapace with muted antique gold edges and dark charcoal joints. Not humanoid, not robot. Low three-quarter poised hunting stance facing left on ruined charcoal stone. Sickle inner edges carry restrained red-orange ember light; a single smoldering ember near a foreleg visualizes planting then reigniting coal. Deep desaturated blue ruins behind with a little warm ember haze. Avoid a wall of fire that hides the silhouette.

cards.name: Giáp Hươu Mạch Suối
cards.body:
Khai Dạng trong lượt này.
Đòn vũ khí đầu tiên hồi một ít HP. Lượng hồi tăng nếu bạn mất HP ở lượt địch vừa qua.
cards.subject: A DIAMONDS / WATER: an unmistakable stag beetle creature, broad head with TWO large paired antler-like serrated STAG MANDIBLES spreading forward, no single rhinoceros horn. Six sturdy articulated insect legs and rounded low wing cases. Slate-blue to aquamarine chitin, restrained warm bronze seams, matte painted broad planes rather than glossy gemstone facets. Three-quarter view facing left, standing in a shallow spring coursing through blue ruined stones. A clear curling stream flows gently around forelegs and pale ripples radiate from its chest, expressing restoration rather than ice or shields. Preserve full mandibles within frame, no turtle shell, no humanoid knight.

cards.name: Nhện Dệt Nền
cards.body:
Khai Dạng trong lượt này.
Lá vũ khí đầu tiên tạo Khiên được tăng Khiên.
cards.subject: A CLUBS / EARTH: an unmistakable large original spider creature with exactly EIGHT clearly articulated legs attached to its cephalothorax, two body masses, low heavy rounded abdomen, two small pedipalps which are visibly shorter than walking legs. Matte graphite and muted mineral-green chitin, selected antique ochre stone plates, delicate gold-brown web strands grounded between broken stones. Three-quarter stance facing left. The web supports broad stone slabs rising into a low partial protective wall, evoking weaving foundations and strengthening shields. Navy ruined underground courtyard, muted moss and subdued earthen planes, restrained mysterious eye glints. Make eight-leg silhouette readable; no scorpion tail, no beetle horns, no human, no enormous extra spectral spider.
